post.description: Create a new request in DigiStudio from a standard or custom template

customer_identifier.description: Email/mobile phone number of the customer to which the KYC request is sent.

notify_customer.description: If true, a notification is sent to the customer on their email/mobile phone. Recommendation: if using only SDK then pass false in notify_customer param

customer_notification_mode.description: Sends an SMS/Whatsapp notification if the identifier is mobile number

customer_name.description: Name of the customer. Max length: 100

reference_id.description: Customer reference number (underscore or alphanumeric string supported). If not passed, one will be auto generated by Digio

transaction_id.description: Unique identifier referring to transaction (underscore or alphanumeric string supported). If not passed, one will be auto generated by Digio

template_name.description: Name of KYC template created over dashboard to be used while creating the request.

preset_values.description: Can be used to prefill form feilds or digilocker linked attributes in the KYC flow

additionalProperties.description: Attributes using which additional documents can be fetched from digilocker(Not applicable for AADHAAR). E.g {"PAN":{"pan_number":"ABCDEF123","name":"Test name"}})
Attributes using which additional documents can be fetched from digilocker(Not applicable for AADHAAR). E.g {"PAN":{"pan_number":"ABCDEF123","name":"Test name"}})

digilocker_document_attributes.description: Attributes using which additional documents can be fetched from digilocker(Not applicable for AADHAAR). E.g {"PAN":{"pan_number":"ABCDEF123","name":"Test name"}})

expire_in_days.description: Request Expiry in number of days => Default: 10 days, After expiry user will not be able to proceed

generate_access_token.description: Default false, if you need an access token then pass this. If allowed for other input details, will receive an access_token object in response(For SDKs only).

collection_amount.description: As Part of the Customer Onboarding Journey Clients can charge their customer. Amount to be charged can be configured here.

estamp_tags.description: E Stamp Certificate ID consumed during document creation

generate_deeplink_info.description: Flag indicating whether to generate Deep link Info

details.description: Details about the exception. Usually contains the exception id for reference.

created_at.description: Time of creation of a request.

status.description: Status of the request. “requested” immediately post creation

customer_identifier.description: Customer email/phone number as passed in the request.

actions.description: LIST of details of steps configured in workflow along with approved/reject status

reference_id.description: Internal reference ID as passed in the request.

additionalProperties.description: Data passed in the request that is displayed on the dashboard, usually to help an agent make a decision.

request_details.description: Data passed in the request that is displayed on the dashboard, usually to help an agent make a decision.

transaction_id.description: As passed in the request. Generated by the system and returned if not passed.

expire_in_days.description: No. of days after which the KYC request will expire.

reminder_registered.description: States if there is any reminder registered.

auto_approved.description: A flag indicating that the file should automatically move on the Approved State or not

additional_plugin_invocations.description: Plugin to be invoked upon KYC request reaching a particular status (can be configured by the client)

template_id.description: Unique identifier for Workflow template created over dashboard (generated by Digio, e.g: KTP12345678)

entity_id.description: Unique identifier of the parent entity the access token belongs to

id.description: Unique identifier referencing an access token

valid_till.description: DateTime at which the access token expires. New token can be generated when expired with the access token generation API mentioned in the document.

GatewayToken.description: Only applicable while creating sign request when generate access token value is passes as “true”

confidence.description: Confidence below which the match fails

identifier.description: Email address or mobile of user

reason.description: Signing reason for user from whom signature is requested

sign_type.description:
'aadhaar' : sign using aadhaar. [default]
'dsc' : sign using DSC
'electronic' : Screen pad based signature (slate signature)

signature_mode.description: mode of signature, if sign_type is electronic

signer_tag.description: Signer tag as mentioned in the template created over dashboard.

signing_addons.description: Additional sign features added upon document signing

optional.description: pass true if geo location is optional

SigningAddon.description: Additional sign features added upon document signing

UpiDeeplinkInfo.description: Deep intent meta for reverse penny drop

execution_request_id.description: equivalent to Digilocker request ID or Form request ID or reverse penny drop request ID

processing_done.description: Flag that identifies whether the processing of the request is done or not

retry_count.description: Configurable rules that determines how many retries the request is allowed to do

KycActionResponse.description: LIST of details of steps configured in workflow along with approved/reject status

tags.description:
Map of tag names and quantities to be attached. Tag names should be without spaces
Note : Do not pass any special character or space in E-stamp tag name. Available tag names can be checked on dashboard -> E-Stamping section

MergeEstampRequest.description: Details of Estamps, Quantities to be consumed and other merge details like
